gen-righteous-gf-georama: Georama reads like a plain sans with a bracelet-wide c and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Righteous sits over it as a rigid, unmodulated rod of a heading, bold where the text stays modest.
gen-righteous-gf-gidole: Gidole keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, with a high midline and a neon-tube consistency in every stroke. Righteous, though, is the one for filling the line with big commanding bowls, while Gidole handles the sustained sentences in sans-serif quiet.
gen-righteous-gf-golos-text: Fun, loud bowls up top, then a text face that fills its line. Golos Text, built from one stroke width with a widely parted s, would carry a long passage in sans-serif comfort beneath Righteous without tiring the eye.
gen-righteous-gf-heebo: Heebo brings a tall central band and curves that stop short. Righteous pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle, and that stubborn, rounded heft against Heebo's restraint is exactly what makes the pair memorable.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-guntur: Commanding bowls fill the line in Righteous, drawn like thin steel rod, while Hind Guntur stands below with tall lowercase forms like stamped metal type. And since its letters already run large, the body size can usually drop a notch without losing any clarity.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-madurai: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line, which gives every heading a confident, playful punch. And Hind Madurai does the quieter job, with wide-open s curves and lowercase that fills its line like capitals, in a plain sans manner.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase tops close to the ascender height. Beneath the rod-like bowls of Righteous it would read as a plain sans with no calligraphic thinning, each a left ajar, moving smoothly down a long passage.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-siliguri: Those bowls that fill the line, bent like thin steel rod, are the loudest thing about Righteous. Hind Siliguri hums along beneath in sans fashion with constant line weight, and its gentle capital bump means the size can stay modest.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-vadodara: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that crowd the line. Hind Vadodara counters with direction-proof thickness and spacious gaps in its rounded forms, a clean, professional steadiness that makes the whole pair feel dependable.
